# Kerllos Ayad – Shopify Developer in Cairo, Egypt

> Shopify and Angular developer in Cairo, Egypt (4+ years). Conversion-focused Shopify stores and scalable Angular front ends for Egypt and the Middle East.

Kerllos Ayad is a Shopify and Angular developer and Senior Frontend Engineer based in Cairo, Egypt, with 4+ years of experience. Current role: Senior Frontend Engineer at MCV (Manufacturing Commercial Vehicles). Serves clients in Egypt and Middle East.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://k-ayad.com/services): three Shopify services and three Angular services

Shopify:
- [Shopify store setup and design](https://k-ayad.com/services/shopify-store-setup): A new store set up properly: theme, collections, payments, shipping and a clean brand-matched design.
- [Custom Shopify themes and features](https://k-ayad.com/services/shopify-theme-customization): Custom sections, product page logic, variant swatches and metafield-driven content, written in Liquid.
- [Shopify speed and SEO optimization](https://k-ayad.com/services/shopify-speed-seo-optimization): Faster pages, clean markup and structured data, so the store loads quickly and can be found.

Angular:
- [Angular web app development](https://k-ayad.com/services/angular-web-app-development): Angular and TypeScript web applications, built from reusable components and connected to your APIs.
- [Angular front-end engineering](https://k-ayad.com/services/angular-frontend-engineering): Senior engineering for Angular teams: new features, TypeScript components and data-heavy screens.
- [Angular SEO and prerendering](https://k-ayad.com/services/angular-seo-prerendering): Prerendered Angular pages with their own titles, canonical URLs and structured data, so crawlers can read them.

## Skills
Shopify, Liquid, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, UI/UX
